items.title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vllm'

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

items.body: I try to run dynamo in a ubuntu24.04 docker container, but meet an error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vllm'. **Host Environment** - Host OS: Ubuntu 20.04 - Host Arch: x86_64 - Host Driver Version: 570.124.06, CUDA Version: 12.8 - GPU Cards: RTX3090 * 8 **Container Environment** - Docker Image: nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu24.04 from docker-hub - Command to start container: docker run -itd --name ubuntu24.04_dev -v /data/user1/container_volume:/data/user1/container_volume -v /data_mnt:/data_mnt --runtime=nvidia --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu24.04 /bin/bash - Python Version: 3.11.5 **Steps in container** - Follow the Installation in Readme, i.e., ``` apt-get update DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -yq python3-dev python3-pip python3-venv libucx0 python3 -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate pip install ai-dynamo[all] ``` - Run a model locally using vLLM backend `dynamo run out=vllm --model-path /data_mnt/model_zoo/deepseek/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B` **Console Output** ``` (venv) root@bc445a1cf121:/data/user1/container_volume/ubuntu24.04_dev/repo# dynamo run out=vllm --model-path /data_mnt/model_zoo/deepseek/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B thread 'tokio-runtime-worker' panicked at lib/llm/src/engines/vllm/worker.rs:247:17: Failed to import python 'vllm' module. Are we running in the correct venv?
